question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Accolade
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Accolade"** means **an award or privilege granted as a special honor or as an acknowledgment of merit. **(सम्मान)

 
 
• **Example: **She received an **accolade** for her outstanding performance in the play.
 
 
 
• **"Criticism" **refers to the expression of disapproval of someone or something based on perceived faults or mistakes. (आलोचना)
 
 
• **Example: **The author's new book faced a lot of **criticism** for its controversial subject matter.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Accolade' **is **'Criticism'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Tribute **(श्रद्धांजलि): An act, statement, or gift that is intended to show gratitude, respect, or admiration.

 
 
• **Example:** The community paid tribute to the local hero for his bravery.
 
 
 
• **Promotion **(प्रमोशन): The action of raising someone to a higher position or rank.
 
 
• **Example: **She received a promotion due to her excellent work performance.
 
 
 
• **Assurance** (आश्वासन): A positive declaration intended to give confidence; a promise.
 
 
• **Example:** He gave her assurance that everything would be fine.
